task: Harden agent response reliability and a memory-bank context sanitization gap, per user request 'harden the design if possible and implement' following calibration-observed truncation failures and a 'are there any guardrails we are missing' question. Implemented: format:'json' structured output (base.ts, coverageAnalyst.ts, not testGen.ts which outputs raw code); a Stage 4 truncated-response recovery path in BaseAgent.parseFindings with a schema-validation safety net against a real '{}' garbage-response regression caught during implementation; sanitizeText() in sanitizer.ts wired into runner.ts's withContext to close a real gap where memory-bank context was never actually sanitized despite a code comment claiming it was; a sanitizer 'act as a' false-positive fix found via dogfooding against this repo's own real memory-bank files. Follow-up (2026-07-26, per /code-review gate findings, user-approved): extracted extractBalancedSpan/extractCompleteObjects into parsing.ts as shared helpers (fixing a reproduced negative-depth bug and eliminating 3 near-duplicate hand-rolled scanners), and gave CoverageAnalystAgent.parseCoverageResult a Stage 3 truncation-recovery path matching BaseAgent's, closing the truncation-parity gap 4 of 5 domain reviewers independently flagged.
